non_destructive.content_addressing: Segments are character spans plus sha256, pinned to source_artifact_sha256. Resolving a span requires the pinned artifact and fails closed when the artifact changes.
non_destructive.legacy_fields: preserved verbatim under each record's legacy.fields

class_meanings.FOUNDER_ADOPTED: material he explicitly took as his own
class_meanings.NONFOUNDER_PASTED: third-party content pasted into a founder-authored message
class_meanings.UNRESOLVED_USER_ROLE: authorship not determinable from evidence in scope; the user role proves who typed it, not who authored it
